name: [🍕PIZZA] TMNT Battle Tycoon
desc:
🏗️ Build your own Turtle base with an armory, dojo, arcade, and more!
🐢 Battle as Leo, Mikey, Raph, and Donnie against bosses like Shredder, Bebop, Rat King, and Superfly - with more to come!
⚔️ Unlock & equip powerful weapons to take down enemies.
🕳️ Explore dungeons beneath the city for epic rewards.
🎮 Play on PC, Console, Tablet & Mobile.
🍕 EAT PIZZA! COWABUNGA!
